new_writes_frontmatter_note.statement: new creates <id>.md with YAML frontmatter (title, tags, created) and the body in the notes directory, creating it if missing.
must_include: notes stored as .md with YAML frontmatter in ~/.note-taker

list_search_filters.statement: list --tag filters by tag and list --search filters by case-insensitive keyword in title or body.

show_prints_or_fails.statement: show prints the note and exits 1 for an unknown id.
must_include: subcommands new list show edit delete

edit_and_delete.statement: edit launches $EDITOR on the note file and delete removes it; both exit 1 for an unknown id.
must_include: subcommands new list show edit delete

single_file_stdlib.statement: note_taker.py imports only standard library modules.
